column1: Elderas was shattered in the Nightfall of 217 A.R., when the Celestine Bridge collapsed and the inner sea poured into the Rift.
Nyxas mints blackglass coins stamped with a crescent sigil used by guild warrants and gatekeepers.
Catacomb gates beneath Nyxas Keep only open for bearers of a crimson sigil carried over the heart.
